description.value: Despite the cybernetics, you are still very much a living being and within your soul beats the indomitable spirit of mortality that lets you exceed the limits of both flesh and steel. Once per day you can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Moment of Renewal] as an 8th-rank primal innate spell, targeting up to 6 living creatures within 100 feet who can hear the primal bellow affirming the nature of your heart and soul, including yourself.
